title: Lists
subtitle: The short lists the rest of the system chooses from. Nothing is ever deleted: a record is deactivated with a reason.
codeFixed: The code never changes once the record is created.
accountsNeedPermission: Choosing an account needs the "View journal entries" permission.

units.title: Units of measure
units.einvoiceHint: Optional: the unit code the e-invoicing provider asks for (e.g. H87, KGM).
units.einvoiceRule: Up to 3 capital letters or digits.
units.note: A quantity can never have more decimals than its unit allows.

vat.title: VAT categories

meaning.OS: Outside the scope of UAE VAT

vat.empty: The VAT categories could not be shown.
vat.noteOwner: These are the four UAE VAT categories: none can be added or removed. A rate change applies to new documents only; issued documents never change.
vat.noteOthers: These are the four UAE VAT categories. Only the owner can change a rate.
vat.saved: VAT rate changed. New documents use it from now on.
vat.rateRule: Write a rate above 0%, with at most 2 decimals (e.g. 5 or 5.25).
vat.dialogNote: The new rate applies to new documents only; issued documents keep their rate. The change is written to the audit log with your reason.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.kindFixed: The kind never changes once the method is created.
paymentMethods.accountHint: Where the money received is recorded: an asset account such as cash, bank or cheques in hand.
paymentMethods.whereRule: Make it available in the POS, the office, or both.
paymentMethods.requiresReference: Needs a reference number (e.g. card slip or cheque number)

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.techniciansNeedPermission: Choosing a technician needs the "Manage technicians" permission.
warehouses.vanNeedsTechnician: A van belongs to a technician: choose one.
warehouses.note: There is always exactly one default warehouse. Making another one the default moves the mark; the default cannot be deactivated.

businessLines.title: Lines of business
businessLines.revenueHint: Sales of this line are recorded here (net of discount).
businessLines.cogsHint: The cost of the goods sold in this line is recorded here.
businessLines.note: Revenue and cost of sales are split by line of business (decision 0018). The accounts are provisional until the accountant approves the chart.

reasons.title: Reason codes
reasons.categoryFixed: The category never changes once the reason is created.
reasons.accountRequired: Money paid in or out is recorded in an account: choose one.

accountHint.in: Money paid in to the drawer is credited to this account.
accountHint.out: Money paid out from the drawer is charged to this account (e.g. petty cash expenses).

reasons.requiresNoteLong: The person must also write a note when choosing this reason
reasons.note: Only reasons for money paid in or out of the drawer post to an account.
